notes: Use شُكْرًا لَك (shukran lak) for 'thank you (to you)' and شُكْرًا عَلَى (shukran ʿalā) for 'thanks for'.
The common reply is عَفْوًا (ʿafwan, 'you're welcome'), and 'thank you very much' is شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا (shukran jazīlan).
